system.description: As a bonus action, you exhale a thin halo of mist that clings to you for the next minute. While shrouded in this way, yourself an allied creatures that begin their turns within 10 feet of you gain a rank of mastery to Stealth checks and a +10 bonus to your speed. This increases to two ranks at 7th. Suffering the hostile effects of a jutsu with the Wind or Lightning Release keyword ends this effect early. Once this effect is used, you cannot do so again until they complete a short rest.
